utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Can we sort the logistics first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, totally — I’ve mostly heard bits second-hand, so I’m not the best on the details, but I can help track down who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive needs? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — it’s on Saturday at 10:00 a.m., and we need help with basic home repairs like fixing a leaky faucet, patching a wall, and a little yard work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—could you bring some heavy-duty tape, a couple extension cords, and a screwdriver set? If you’ve got time, I could also use help sorting the donated supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I meant to keep an eye on that. Has anything changed yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’ve got a few tools set aside in case they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list and timing sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll spread the word and see who still needs to add their items. Just send me the time and place once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, though I’m keeping things a bit low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in if you still need another pair of hands—I usually end up showing up late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Leo, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on. I’ll be there this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks updated if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — I’ll note that and keep an eye on where things stand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like the repair drive is really coming together — how can I help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Jules — I could use help sorting donations and keeping an eye on the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—if you need anything dropped off or picked up while I’m out, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — I might take you up on that if something comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in. Tell me what you need me to bring or help with.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara. Could you bring a flashlight, a pair of work gloves, and meet me at the shed at 9?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. People around here are always up for pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure people will actually show up?
